en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al hakam, from Aban, from a man, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The match is that he happens to be chaste, and with him is wealth’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Aban from a man who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Proper match is one who is chaste and affluent.’”
